'''''Gauntlet''''' was a [[Kom'rk-class fighter/transport/Legends|''Kom'rk''-class fighter/transport]] owned by the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] [[Soldier/Legends|soldier]] [[Pre Vizsla/Legends|Pre Vizsla]]. Designed and constructed by the Mandalorian [[Starship/Legends|starship]] manufacturing corporation, [[MandalMotors/Legends|MandalMotors]], the ''Gauntlet'' measured 52.3 [[Meter/Legends|meters]] in length, and took its name from the [[Galactic Basic Standard/Legends|Basic]] [[Language/Legends|language]] translation of the [[Mando'a/Legends|''Mando'a'']] word, ''Kom'rk''. Equipped with powerful [[Engine/Legends|engines]] and twin [[Laser cannon/Legends|laser cannons]], ''Gauntlet'' fulfilled dual roles as a [[Troop carrier/Legends|troop transport]] and [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]], and was maintained by Vizsla—leader of the radical Mandalorian splinter-group known as the [[Death Watch/Legends|Death Watch]]—as his personal [[Transport/Legends|transport]] during [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]-spanning [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

==Description==
''Gauntlet'' was a [[Kom'rk-class fighter/transport/Legends|''Kom'rk''-class fighter/transport]], and like the smaller models of the ''Kom'rk''-class, measured 52.3 [[Meter/Legends|meters]] in length.<ref name="Etrivia" /><ref name="GauntletFighter" /> ''Gauntlet'' possessed broad, angular, rotating wings<ref name="TCWIV" /> that alternated between an upright landing position when grounded, and a horizontal configuration while flying in the [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmosphere]] or [[Realspace/Legends|space]].<ref name="Eminence" /> The [[Starship/Legends|starship]] was also equipped with dual, forward-facing [[Laser cannon/Legends|laser cannons]] located at the nose of the main body.<ref name="TCWIV" />

==History==
[[File:GauntletTatooine-SoR.png|thumb|left|250px|The ''Gauntlet'' approaches Jabba's palace on Tatooine]]
At some point in [[Time/Legends|time]] prior to [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]],<ref name="Date">''[[Star Wars Annual 2011]]''</ref> the ''Kom'rk''-class line of starships was constructed for the violent and radical Mandalorian splinter-faction known as the [[Death Watch/Legends|Death Watch]] by rogue elements within [[MandalMotors/Legends|MandalMotors]],<ref name="TCWIV" /> a leading Mandalorian starship company based on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Mandalore/Legends|Mandalore]],<ref name="TCSWE">''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]''</ref> within the [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Keldabe/Legends|Keldabe]].<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> By the [[First Battle of Geonosis/Legends|beginning]] of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]—a pan-galactic conflict between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]]—numerous ''Kom'rk''-class fighters had entered into the possession of the [[Death/Legends|Death]] Watch.<ref name="TCWIV" />

==Commanders and crew==
Like all ''Kom'rk''-class fighter/transports, ''Gauntlet'' could be crewed by up to four individuals.<ref name="TCWIV" />
